title: Ines and the Thorn
author: Elodie Oyelaran
blurb: Marguerite Thornbury, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
